newsitem.title: USA: Ascend in Bell Atlantic unit partnership.
newsitem.headline: Ascend in Bell Atlantic unit partnership.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc said it entered a strategic partnership with Bell Atlantic Network Integration (BANI) to provide comprehensive remote access solutions for the corporate marketplace.
Terms of the partnership were not disclosed. Officials from Ascend were not immediately available to comment.
Ascend shares rose two to close at 62 on the news on volume of more than 7.2 million shares.
BANI will market Ascend's end-to-end remote access product line under the agreement, which covers Ascend's Pipeline bridges and routers and MAX and MAX TNT WAN access switches.

BANI, a unit of Bell Atlantic Corp, offers services covering the planning, implementation, management and ongoing support of enterprise networks. Ascend offers networking solutions for corporate central sites, Internet Service Providers' points of presence, remote offices, mobile workers and telecommuters.
